notes.title: Gold Version out now!
notes.notes:
The wait is over! 

We’re thrilled to announce that the Gold Version of CREAMARE: The Game is finally here.
The final release is now available, bringing the full vision of our game to life. 

What’s new in the Gold Update:

Full site access: all 9 submerged locations are now unlocked and fully accessible
Enhanced narrative experience: we have expanded and refined the game’s narrative structure, providing a deeper connection to the scientific and historical context behind each site.
New Audio Tracks to enhance the emotional and educational experience throughout your dives.
Improved gameplay mechanics: core mechanics have been optimized for smoother interaction and better overall playability.
Gallery feature is now available: you can save and view your underwater photographs taken in Photo Mode thanks to the brand-new Gallery function. Capture, revisit, and share your favorite moments from the deep.

Thank you for your support and feedback!
New features are on the way, so stay tuned and keep exploring with us.

The Development Team 💙

notes.title: Update v0.2.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to announce the release of version 0.2.5 of our game! This update brings various improvements, optimizations, and fixes to enhance your gaming experience. Here are the key highlights:

Your feedback matters! Many of the improvements in this update are based on the valuable insights we received from you, our players. Keep them coming!

🔧 Improvements & Fixes 
Fixed some visual boundary issues for a smoother experience.

Optimized player and object collisions for better interactions.

Improved shader effects for more dynamic visuals.

Performance optimizations for a more fluid gameplay experience.

Enhanced the logic of some in-game elements, making them more immersive and realistic.

🎯 UI Improvements

New on-screen indicators to help you reach your objectives more easily.

Updated main menu with a refreshed UI and improved logo.

Better button layout in menus for more intuitive navigation.

Refined input responsiveness for smoother controls.

🎬 Cinematics & Immersion

New cinematic sequence in the Museum, featuring a dramatic creature arrival and dynamic camera work to enhance immersion.

🔜 Work in Progress

We are working on new environments, which will be gradually added to the game. Our goal is to bring you a total of 9 real-world dive sites that you will be able to explore and play in!

We are continuing to improve audio to make the atmosphere even more engaging.

More UI enhancements on the way, with further optimizations to the game interface.

Thank you for your support and feedback! 
Stay tuned, stay dive, and get ready for more exciting updates! 🚀

Enjoy the game and see you soon!
The Development Team 💙
